visual.name: advanVisSmartBar
visual.description: Bar and column charts with a variance chart and locally calculated insights that explain your data in plain English. Free: bars, columns, stacked, clustered and 100% stacked, lollipops, automatic direction, axis break for an outlier, Pareto line, Top N with a working Other bar, average, median and fixed lines, highest and lowest highlighting, category images, fx colours, scrolling, drill-down, vector export and a basic headline. Pro (one-month free trial): the full smart headline and findings with How calculated, smart design tips, the IBCS-style variance chart, change against last period, and targets scored met or missed.
